global_style: A refined, artistic template featuring muted watercolor edge accents, white overlay content cards, and crisp geometric highlight shapes.

identity_anchors: Organic, asymmetrical watercolor-style textures restricted to the slide margins
Prominent use of circles as primary containers for titles, metrics, and images
Inner white rectangular canvas with subtle shadows to frame slide content
Pill-shaped rounded rectangles for secondary labels or buttons

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
